decision: prefers-reduced-motion zeroes ALL transitions (0.01ms) instead of gentler-not-zero
why: Reveal never hides under RM (JS guard) and no content is gated behind opacity, so the nuke costs polish only; revisit if comprehension-aiding fades appear

decision: Bento TILE keeps hover lift on non-link sections
why: Brief signature move (annotated-record card language); flagged as affordance risk by motion+visual reviewers, accepted deliberately

decision: Bezel tilt: duration-500 + hover:duration-700 = 700ms settle-in on hover, 500ms release
why: CSS applies the target state's duration; matches motion spec (slow settle in, faster out); visual-critic 'inverted' verdict was against a misworded changelog line, not the code

decision: DOB select chevron is a data-URI SVG with hardcoded #5c7386 stroke
why: data-URI cannot carry a CSS var; dims slightly in dark mode, acceptable

decision: Landing hero teaser stack floats at 7-9s infinite (ambient layer)
why: Brand surface, MOTION dial 5; ambient != interaction motion; global reduced-motion block zeroes it (detector checks per-file and cannot see the global guard)

decision: Delta placeholder renders a typographic em dash for absent values
why: Data placeholder, not prose; standard tabular convention

decision: Light primary #1e2a39 -> #24405f (hover #2d4f75, pressed #16293f, selection matched)
why: Audit COLOR 6.6: primary was functionally ink, deleting every accent moment (hover:text-primary invisible). Arctic navy identity kept, chroma raised; white-on-primary ~10:1

decision: --default-transition-duration 200ms + --default-transition-timing-function var(--ease-house); buttons moved 500->200ms; Card/TILE lift stays 500
why: Kills the second de-facto motion system (~30 bare transition-colors sites at Tailwind defaults) and the laggy 500ms hover colors; press stays 150

decision: Four bespoke landing rgba(15,23,42) shadows collapsed into one --el-bezel token (themed, dark tinted rgba(3,10,20)); dark --el-* also tinted off pure black
why: Tokens-only rule; slate family was off the ink ramp and dead in dark mode

decision: --c-ink-tertiary removed; all usages -> ink-subtle
why: Token duplicated ink-subtle (#5b7080 vs #5c7386): a 3-step ramp that rendered as 2; lightening instead would fail AA on small meta text

decision: Console pages moved to panel/(console)/ with a layout owning requireSpecialistOrg (React cache) + ConsoleShell; nueva-organizacion stays outside the group
why: Shell persists across navigations, per-segment loading replaces content only, 5x guard boilerplate deleted; the org-less redirect target must not sit behind the org guard

decision: Blob uploads stay route handlers (8-10MB > server-action body limit) but submit via fetch (UploadForm): pending, double-submit guard, inline error, router.refresh; routes return JSON instead of redirects
why: Fixes the reload + sticky ?error=1 UX without fighting the body-limit constraint that motivated route handlers

decision: Detail page: 13 stacked cards -> 12-col bento (7/5 pairs, wide rows for notes/body/erase), one Promise.all batch for all 14 reads, double-bezel identity header
why: Worst UX page and worst perf page fixed in one move; bezel exports the landing signature into the console

decision: Dark --c-primary #9db4c6 -> #8dbde6 (hover #a5cbee); accent-text + selection-bg follow; ink-subtle/focus-ring keep #9db4c6
why: Audit 0.7.3: four tokens collapsed into one hex left dark mode with zero accents (links = muted text, chart lines same hue). Measured 9.66:1 on canvas, 8.8:1 on surface-1

decision: RecordSection flips the grid template together with the order swap
why: order-* moves the item, not the track: asymmetric [1fr_280px] + order alone put the record card in the 280px column on all flipped sections (arithmetically certain, shipped since the landing rebuild)

decision: Double bezel extracted to src/components/ui/bezel.tsx (radius prop keeps concentric math); consumed by the landing record beats and the console dashboard protagonist tile
why: Signature was inline on the landing only; the paid daily surface failed the covered-logo test. One primitive, two surfaces, no duplication

decision: Messages/diet/training single-button cards collapse into one 'Plan y seguimiento' ledger card (12 cols); notes drops to 7 to pair with medication (5)
why: Three enclosures doing no grouping work; bento rows still sum to 12 in every content state

decision: Three radial halos kept (hero, proof orb, auth): primary-subtle token, low opacity, structural framing of the first viewport
why: Registry flags decorative orbs; these are on-token, quiet and predate the flagged-pattern rule. Revisit if a render shows them reading as generic SaaS glow

decision: Three equal problem cards kept on the landing
why: The anti-reference targets 3-equal-FEATURE cards; these carry the reader's own problems in their words (WhatsApp/Excel/PDF), a set that reads as parallel by design. Structural variation proposed but not applied without a render

decision: Landing byline 'Por Alejandro · fundador de Nutrionyx' is the founder's real public name
why: Owner confirmed 2026-08-12. Closes the standing CONTENT_INTEGRITY risk (an attributed human byline is a trust claim; a fabricated one would have been CRITICAL, score cap 49). Audits must not re-flag it
